crossRefs.note: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted…
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

translations.web: You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh‘s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
translations.bsb: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
translations.asv: Thou shalt also be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
